source: Deadlock Counter Buying Guide web guide v0.8 (extracted 2026-11-26)

heroes.name: Abrams
heroes.note: Siphon Life drains HP from everyone nearby — he wins long brawls by out-healing your damage.

abilities.desc: Drain life from nearby enemies, dealing 22 spirit damage per second for 4 seconds and healing for 70% of the damage dealt (35% against non-heroes).
abilities.name: Siphon Life
tiers: +2m Radius and +22 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun. If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
tiers: -18s Cooldown; On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

abilities.desc: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
abilities.name: Infernal Resilience

abilities.desc: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
abilities.name: Seismic Impact
tiers: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

heroes.name: Apollo
heroes.note: Riposte no longer triggers off bullets — it reflects them; only abilities and items trigger it. Pommel Hit no longer disarms — it knocks you up, slows you 50% and blocks stamina for 2s.

abilities.desc: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
tiers: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

abilities.desc: Prepare to deflect all incoming ability damage. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and gain the ability to dash to an enemy hero whose attack you deflected. Hitting them deals spirit damage, knocks them back, applies slow and prevents stamina usage. While deflecting, bullets are reflected back at the attacker.
abilities.name: Riposte
tiers: +1s Debuff Duration; Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.desc: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.
abilities.name: Flawless Advance
tiers: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.

abilities.desc: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.
abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn

heroes.name: Baba
heroes.note: S-tier frontliner. Baba's Brew cycles barrier, silence and burn; Threadsap now lasts 10s (was 16s) and her Spirit Resist scaling was cut again on 26 Nov. Feed The Birds hits harder (max damage 650) but Indomitable now blocks the pigeon.

abilities.desc: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit, Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.
abilities.name: Threadsap

abilities.desc: Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance. Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup, slow, and deals spirit damage. Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.
abilities.name: Granny Long Legs

abilities.desc: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist. Press Zoom / alt-fire to pause or resume brewing.
abilities.name: Baba's Brew

abilities.desc: Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking slow. When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
abilities.name: Feed The Birds
tiers: +125 Max Damage, +1.5 Spirit Scaling, +0.5s Max Duration

heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.note: One Grapple Arm hook makes it a 5v6. His Hyper Beam is a channel — it can be interrupted.

abilities.desc: Perform an uppercut dealing 63.01 melee damage that launches enemies into the air; on landing, deal 75 spirit damage in a 14m radius and apply -14% fire rate.
abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
tiers: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

abilities.desc: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.
abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
tiers: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

abilities.desc: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.
abilities.name: Grapple Arm

abilities.desc: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.
abilities.name: Hyper Beam
tiers: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

heroes.name: Billy
heroes.note: Chain Gang drags you into a brawl on his terms. Complexity-3 chaos pick who disrupts grouped teams.

abilities.desc: Slam your bat into the ground dealing 45 melee damage and 35 spirit damage, knocking enemies up for 0.4s.
abilities.name: Bashdown
tiers: -3s Charge Time; Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.desc: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.
abilities.name: Rising Ram

abilities.desc: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7s. Active: Bullets are amplified against wrecked enemies. Using melee boosts max health and extends duration.
abilities.name: Blasted
tiers: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage. The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
abilities.name: Chain Gang
tiers: +5m Range; +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

heroes.name: Calico
heroes.note: Burst assassin with a cat companion (Ava) amplifying her damage. Squishy if you survive the first combo.

abilities.desc: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage. Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
abilities.name: Gloom Bombs
tiers: Per Bomb Touch: -6% Melee Resist for 6s

abilities.desc: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage. If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
abilities.name: Leaping Slash
tiers: +100 Damage & On Hero Hit: 60% Cooldown Refund

abilities.desc: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap. Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
abilities.name: Ava
tiers: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 8s

abilities.desc: Return to the shadows and explode after a 3s delay, dealing 150 spirit damage and gaining 20% move speed.
abilities.name: Return to Shadows
tiers: On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

heroes.name: Celeste
heroes.note: Dazzling Trick silences you; Radiant Daggers stack Spirit Amp. Her ult and silence were nerfed on 4 Nov, but the burst is still real.

abilities.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
abilities.name: Light Eater

abilities.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
tiers: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+0.75 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.desc: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.
abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
tiers: -22s Cooldown, +70 Impact Damage and +5m Cast Range
+9% Fire Rate per Stack; +5% Spirit Amp per Stack

abilities.desc: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
abilities.name: Shining Wonder

heroes.name: Deadman Danny
heroes.note: Chimera Mk1 jetpack keeps him airborne, and Close The Deal carries one enemy into the sky — execute bonus cut to +55% on 4 Nov.

abilities.desc: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow. Hold and drag to select the angle.
abilities.name: Strix Salvo
tiers: +2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.desc: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
tiers: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

abilities.desc: Spray fuel dealing 30 weapon damage per second and 35 spirit burst damage, reducing enemies' bullet resist by 15% for 7s.
abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
tiers: +60 Burst Damage; On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s
-10% Bullet Resist Shred; On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.desc: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.
abilities.name: Close The Deal

heroes.name: The Doorman
heroes.note: Doorway links two points of the map and Hotel Guest removes a target to the Baroness Hotel — fights start and end where he wants.

abilities.desc: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow. Can be shot to detonate early.
abilities.name: Call Bell

abilities.desc: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
abilities.name: Doorway
tiers: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.desc: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with Alternate cast to target friendly heroes instead.
abilities.name: Luggage Cart
tiers: +25m Cast Range; +90 Damage on wall impact
-18s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

abilities.desc: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.
abilities.name: Hotel Guest
tiers: +150 Damage; +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied; 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

heroes.name: Drifter
heroes.note: Roaming hybrid assassin who picks off isolated targets and slips away. Punish him when his mobility is spent.

abilities.desc: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
abilities.name: Rend
tiers: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage; Silences enemies for 2s if close range

abilities.desc: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
abilities.name: Stalker's Mark

abilities.desc: Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar. You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.
abilities.name: Bloodscent
tiers: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

abilities.desc: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed.
abilities.name: Eternal Night

heroes.name: Dynamo
heroes.note: Singularity pulls your whole team into one spot — the best teamfight ult in the game. Rejuvenating Aurora keeps his team healed through it.

abilities.desc: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
tiers: On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

abilities.desc: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. Alternate cast: Bring nearby allies with you.
abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
tiers: Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50%; Replenishes 1 Charge

abilities.desc: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
tiers: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

abilities.desc: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Singularity

heroes.name: Graves
heroes.note: Highest win rate in Nov 2026 (57.1%). Lock-on gun, ghoul summons that push lanes while he's somewhere else. Low mobility, low burst.

abilities.desc: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
abilities.name: Jar of Dead
tiers: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

abilities.desc: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast Alternate cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
abilities.name: Grasping Hands

abilities.desc: Your weapon steals up to 25% of enemies' max weapon damage and 10% of their max spirit resist over 4s, affecting up to 3 targets.
abilities.name: Essence Theft
tiers: +1 Max Steal Targets; All Summons now apply Essence Theft

abilities.desc: Active: Create a gravestone at a target location that summons Ghouls over time. Enemies can destroy the gravestone with two heavy melees.
abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
tiers: On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage; -0.3s Time To Spawn

heroes.name: Grey Talon
heroes.note: Long-range bow poke with spirit-scaled damage. Deadly from distance, folds when dived.

abilities.desc: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or Fire to hold the shot.
abilities.name: Charged Shot
tiers: Improved damage scaling; Ricochets once off walls, floors, and ceilings

abilities.desc: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. Alternate cast for reduced jump height. Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
tiers: While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

abilities.desc: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage. Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
abilities.name: Spirit Snare

abilities.desc: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold Move forward to accelerate the owl. Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
abilities.name: Guided Owl
tiers: After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health

heroes.name: Haze
heroes.note: Sleep Dagger into a point-blank Bullet Dance. The only gun build among Nov's top-hero tables — and she hunts isolated targets.

abilities.desc: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
tiers: -10% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6s on wake-up
Applies 15 Fixation Stacks; -17s Cooldown; -40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

abilities.desc: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
tiers: Dispels non-ult debuffs; Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

abilities.desc: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
abilities.name: Fixation
tiers: 40 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+0.11/ per Stack; Scales with Weapon Damage

abilities.desc: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
abilities.name: Bullet Dance
tiers: +7 Weapon Damage, +10% Fire Rate, +3m Movespeed, +40% Evasion, -65s Cooldown

heroes.name: Holliday
heroes.note: Catch-and-burst initiator with drone utility. Demanding kit, but a landed catch usually means a kill.

abilities.desc: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup. The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.
abilities.name: Powder Keg
tiers: +40 Impact Damage; +13.3333 Burn Damage per Second

abilities.desc: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
abilities.name: Bounce Pad
tiers: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

abilities.desc: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
abilities.name: Crackshot
tiers: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

abilities.desc: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun. Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.
abilities.name: Spirit Lasso

heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.note: Afterburn burns you over time and Napalm's T2 lifesteal (20% since 30 Oct) keeps him alive while he dives. Concussive Combustion stuns after a 3.25s delay.

abilities.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.
abilities.name: Napalm
tiers: Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

abilities.desc: Dash forward at a max speed of 20m/s, leaving a 4.5m-wide trail for 4s that deals 30 spirit damage per second, with 50% slow resistance.
abilities.name: Flame Dash
tiers: Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time

abilities.desc: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
abilities.name: Afterburn

abilities.desc: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.
abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
tiers: +0.9s Stun Duration and +10m Radius; Increased Spirit Scaling

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.note: Kudzu Connection tethers an ally; Air Drop flies a teammate in — or drops a Stone Form on your head. Saves and engages from the sky.

abilities.desc: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.
abilities.name: Entangling Thorns
tiers: +2m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling
Enemies caught in thorns for 2s are Immobilized for +1.6s

abilities.desc: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection. Connection requires line of sight.
abilities.name: Kudzu Connection

abilities.desc: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
abilities.name: Stone Form
tiers: -25s Cooldown and increased Damage spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies. Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
abilities.name: Air Drop
tiers: On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Silence for 3s on enemies hit.; Increases damage and barrier scaling.

heroes.name: Kelvin
heroes.note: Frozen Shelter domes his whole team. Top-tier support win rate in Nov 2026 — fights inside his dome are fights on his terms.

abilities.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
abilities.name: Frost Grenade
tiers: -10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

abilities.desc: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
abilities.name: Ice Path
tiers: +2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+30% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

abilities.desc: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.
abilities.name: Arctic Beam
tiers: -20% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

abilities.desc: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed. Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
tiers: Applies -20% Fire Rate; Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.; +75 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.note: 56.5% win rate, #2 in Nov 2026 (+2.4 pts after the 4 Nov patch). Life Drain tethers and heals her for 100% of the damage; Soul Exchange swaps her health with yours.

abilities.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
abilities.name: Essence Bomb
tiers: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

abilities.desc: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. Alternate cast to give health to friendly Heroes.
abilities.name: Life Drain
tiers: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

abilities.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
abilities.name: Malice

abilities.desc: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
abilities.name: Soul Exchange
tiers: On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.note: Death Slam comes from directly above. Aerial engage you often don't see until you're already displaced.

abilities.desc: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
abilities.name: Ground Strike
tiers: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

abilities.desc: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
abilities.name: Grapple
tiers: +20m Cast Range and gain +7 Weapon Damage for 6s
+1 Charges; OnCast : +1 Stamina and +60% Air Control; +4m Jump Velocity

abilities.desc: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
abilities.name: Flog
tiers: Apply -28% Move speed for 3s; Apply -30% Fire Rate

abilities.desc: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed. Press Fire to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.
abilities.name: Death Slam
tiers: Stun enemies in Radius for 1.2s; +6m Cast Range

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.note: Mini Turrets aim for her (65% damage vs troopers since 30 Oct), Medicinal Specter heals, and Heavy Barrage is an 8-second homing rocket channel. Very slow, very immobile.

abilities.desc: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
abilities.name: Mini Turret
tiers: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

abilities.desc: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
abilities.name: Medicinal Specter
tiers: +2% Max HP Regen; +3m Heal Radius; +40% Spirit Resist

abilities.desc: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press Fire or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
abilities.name: Spectral Wall
tiers: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s; +24% Slow

abilities.desc: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
abilities.name: Heavy Barrage
tiers: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

heroes.name: Mina
heroes.note: Love Bites stack on gun hits, Rake slashes and heals her, Nox Nostra's bat swarm silences. Oppressive lane, glass cannon.

abilities.desc: Active: Slash with your umbrella, dealing spirit damage, increasing with their missing health. Receive a heal for every target killed. Passive: Holding Zoom / alt-fire causes you to briefly float. Rake executes non-heroes below 60 health.
abilities.name: Rake
tiers: -8s Cooldown; +7% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.
abilities.name: Sanguine Retreat
tiers: On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets

abilities.desc: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage. Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
abilities.name: Love Bites
tiers: +3 Spirit Damage per Bullet & +45 Bonus Damage with increased Spirit scaling
-5 Cooldown; On Proc: +25% Fire Rate for 5s

abilities.desc: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence. Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
abilities.name: Nox Nostra
tiers: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.note: Traveler was reworked on 30 Oct — now a 3s channel that stuns, roots and Slowing Hex can interrupt. Worst win rate in Nov 2026 (43.1%); pressure him, don't fear him.

abilities.desc: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
abilities.name: Fire Scarabs
tiers: +2s Duration; -15% Damage Penalty; Increased Spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.
abilities.name: Dust Devil
tiers: +60 Damage, -12s Cooldown, +30% Evasion, Recast within 6s., Increases spirit scaling.

abilities.desc: Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage. There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks. Active: Consume all Djinn Marks to deal their damage now.
abilities.name: Djinn's Mark
tiers: On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
-0.75s Cooldown; +1 Max Marks; Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks

abilities.desc: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage or being Stunned, Immobilized, put to Sleep or Movement Silenced during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted. After teleporting, gain a Barrier. Alternate cast to target your base's healing area.
abilities.name: Traveler
tiers: Cannot be interrupted by damage; Barrier gains Spirit Scaling

heroes.name: Mo & Krill
heroes.note: Scorn heals him 1.3× from heroes (buffed 4 Nov) and Burrow engages from underground. Combo permanently gains +50 HP per kill.

abilities.desc: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
abilities.name: Scorn
tiers: +1m Radius; Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.

abilities.desc: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.
abilities.name: Burrow

abilities.desc: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.
abilities.name: Sand Blast
tiers: Slow targets by -28% and reduces dash distances by -28%

abilities.desc: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
abilities.name: Combo
tiers: +0.7s Duration and +35 Damage Per Second and increased scaling

heroes.name: Nurse Harrow
heroes.note: Leech Therapy drains you to feed her team, and Lurking Terrors fears anyone looking at her — fear buildup cut to 1.75s and her gun buffed +8% on 4 Nov. Warden is immune to the fear.

abilities.name: Leech Therapy
abilities.desc: Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs. Harrow can pick up leeches after they finish feeding, healing her for the health drained and permanently granting regeneration and fire rate. 25% of your leech stacks are lost on death.
tiers: Leeches drain stamina and restore it to you on pickup
+1m Radius; +0.3 Spirit Scaling; +8 Max Leech Stacks

abilities.name: Wretched Vapors
abilities.desc: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash. Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters. Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage. Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.

abilities.name: Healing Needles
abilities.desc: Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them. Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip. Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.
tiers: +16 Heal Per Shot; Shots restore 0.6 stamina
+0.4 Spirit Scaling; Shots extend non-ultimate buff durations by 6%, up to their max duration

abilities.name: Lurking Terrors
abilities.desc: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities. At max terror, they flee in fear away from you. Each leech you have collected adds fear duration. Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.
tiers: -20% Move Speed and Fire Rate; +30 DPS
+3s Channel Time; +0.5 Spirit Scaling; Takes 50% Reduced Damage while channeling

heroes.name: Paige
heroes.note: 56.4% win rate, top-3 support in Nov 2026. Plot Armor saves an ally and buffs their damage on one button. Low mobility, low burst — catch her, not her carry.

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.desc: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.desc: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.
tiers: Affects up to 2 additional allies.; Increases barrier scaling.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.desc: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
tiers: +2m Radius; On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.desc: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

heroes.name: Paradox
heroes.note: Paradoxical Swap trades places with you — usually into his whole team. One swap is a death sentence if you're out of position.

abilities.name: Pulse Grenade
abilities.desc: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.
tiers: +20 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Time Wall
abilities.desc: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

abilities.name: Kinetic Carbine
abilities.desc: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, Zoom / alt-fire to timeslow your movement.
tiers: +2s Charge Hold Duration and +40% Damage Scaling

abilities.name: Paradoxical Swap
abilities.desc: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.
tiers: 200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage

heroes.name: Pocket
heroes.note: Zone control and burst, but bottom-tier win rate in Nov 2026. Punish the long cooldowns after his combo.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.desc: Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks. Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float. Casting AirDash or Flying Cloak will not cancel Barrage.

abilities.name: Flying Cloak
abilities.desc: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

abilities.name: Enchanter's Satchel
abilities.desc: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.
tiers: +1.5s Duration; +4m Radius; -32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4s

abilities.name: Affliction
abilities.desc: Applies spirit damage over time to enemies nearby. Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
tiers: Prevents all healing; +13 DPS with increased Spirit scaling

heroes.name: Rat King
heroes.note: Rule, Ratannia! gives his whole team damage reduction — the ult has been nerfed three patches running, but he is still a tanky spreadshot carry.

abilities.name: Scrap Grenade
abilities.desc: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow. The grenade can be meleed to knock it away. The final detonation has a longer fuse but increased detonation radius, deals increased bullet damage and applies a stronger slow.
tiers: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.desc: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target. Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.
tiers: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

abilities.name: Royal Pestments
abilities.desc: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.
tiers: Reduce all damage to a max of 250; +10% Max Health as Barrier

abilities.name: Rule, Ratannia!
abilities.desc: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner. Slam the banner into the ground causing the sewers below to violently erupt, dealing bullet damage while applying knockup and slow to all enemies in the area. Rats will swarm out of the sewers, applying Rat Swarm to enemies they hit.

heroes.name: Rem
heroes.note: Sleep and dream utility with team saves. Complexity 3, and the opposite of Warden's clock — Rem gets better the longer the game goes.

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.desc: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.desc: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
tiers: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping; Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.desc: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.desc: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
tiers: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown; Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

heroes.name: Seven
heroes.note: Storm Cloud is a channelled, expanding storm (205s). The purest late-game carry: weak early, no mobility, and his ult can be CC'd out of.

abilities.name: Lightning Ball
abilities.desc: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
tiers: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

abilities.name: Static Charge
abilities.desc: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.desc: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
tiers: +3m Move Speed; +8 Damage and increased scaling

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.desc: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight. While channeling, press Fire to mark the targeted area to be struck with a powerful lightning bolt that knocks enemies away after a 0.25s delay. One use per cast.
tiers: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
+7s Channel Time; +10m Final Radius; +5m Initial Radius

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.note: Bloodletting turns damage taken into a rage-fuelled brawl he sustains through. Kiting him beats trading with him.

abilities.name: Serrated Knives
abilities.desc: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack. Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full knives deal 4% of the target's current health as damage on impact and apply a slow to enemies they bleed.
tiers: +12 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.desc: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack. Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full an echo of Shiv retraces the dash path after a short delay, damaging enemies again.
tiers: -4% Spirit Resist; -2s Cooldown per Hero hit.

abilities.name: Bloodletting
abilities.desc: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage. Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full the amount of damage deferred is increased.

abilities.name: Killing Blow
abilities.desc: Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead. Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 12s Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities. Cooldown is increased by +30% if no hero is impacted.
tiers: +6 m Range; +2 m/s in Full Rage.

heroes.name: Silver
heroes.note: Simple long-range brawler tank. Stands in front, soaks damage, shoots back.

abilities.name: Slam Fire
abilities.desc: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
tiers: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage

abilities.name: Boot Kick
abilities.desc: Dash forward and kick the first enemy hit, dealing melee damage while pushing yourself off and marking them. Shooting the marked target deals spirit damage and removes the mark.
tiers: +80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

abilities.name: Entangling Bola
abilities.desc: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
tiers: +0.75s Debuff Duration.; Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

abilities.name: Lycan Curse
abilities.desc: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
tiers: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

heroes.name: Sinclair
heroes.note: Audience Participation copies an enemy ult for 9s — he is only as strong as the ult he steals. Rabbit Hex turns you into a rabbit for 2s. The game's only complexity-4 hero.

abilities.name: Vexing Bolt
abilities.desc: Fire a bolt of magic that deals spirit damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

abilities.name: Spectral Assistant
abilities.desc: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing spirit damage. While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant. Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

abilities.name: Rabbit Hex
abilities.desc: Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased damage and are unable to perform most actions. Hex does not interrupt abilities.

abilities.name: Audience Participation
abilities.desc: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

heroes.name: Solomon
heroes.note: Chessboard zoning: bishops, Rook Battery, knights that shield allies, and Develop Queen, which now checkmates targets under 100 HP. His gun was nerfed hard on 30 Oct.

abilities.desc: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move (Zoom / alt-fire): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional spirit damage when stepped on. Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.
abilities.name: Setup Bishop
tiers: +1 Square Range; Impacts reduce Spirit Resist by -5%, stacking 5 times

abilities.desc: Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move (Zoom / alt-fire): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.
abilities.name: Kingside Knight
tiers: Can target two allies within radius; On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

abilities.desc: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate: Split the rooks perpendicularly.
abilities.name: Rook Battery
tiers: On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s
On Hit: 5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.desc: Summon a queen that crashes down, dealing spirit damage in an area. After a delay, the queen releases squares in straight lines that deal spirit damage again and apply stun. Heroes hit that are low health are checkmated, executing them. Move (Zoom / alt-fire): The queen leaps to the target location, dealing the same effects again. Re-activate to recall the queen early, ending the ability.
abilities.name: Develop Queen

heroes.name: Venator
heroes.note: Crossbow carry with merciless single-target damage. A precision duellist — miss your engage and he deletes you.

abilities.desc: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.
abilities.name: Consecrating Grenade

abilities.desc: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing 60 weapon damage and pushing enemies back; enemies near a wall take 30 bonus damage and are stunned for 0.6s within 7m.
abilities.name: Gutshot
tiers: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

abilities.desc: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
abilities.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
tiers: +1 Charge; Deal +30% damage against revealed targets

abilities.desc: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage. The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
abilities.name: Ira Domini
tiers: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed

heroes.name: Victor
heroes.note: Shocking Reanimation brings him back swinging — killing him once is not killing him. Forgiving pistol carry with heavy sustain.

abilities.desc: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
abilities.name: Pain Battery
tiers: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Damage yourself for 15% of your current health to gain 100 total health regeneration and 3m move speed.
abilities.name: Jumpstart
tiers: +1 Charge; +50% Debuff Resistance; Increases spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
tiers: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

abilities.desc: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
tiers: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet

heroes.name: Vindicta
heroes.note: Flies above the fight and assassinates from long range. Anything that grounds her makes her a normal, squishy sniper.

abilities.desc: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
abilities.name: Stake

abilities.desc: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
abilities.name: Flight
tiers: Hero Kills Refresh Duration; +10 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

abilities.desc: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.
abilities.name: Crow Familiar

abilities.desc: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.
abilities.name: Assassinate

heroes.name: Violet
heroes.note: Living Ink paints walls that block heroes and projectiles; Abstract Landscape silences anyone who leaves the ring. Huge late scaling, highest skill ceiling of the October heroes.

abilities.desc: Empower (Ability 1): Your next 3 bullets come to life, allowing you to steer them as they travel. The bullets deal increased bullet damage and splash spirit damage in a small area. Each successful hit against a hero reduces all ability cooldowns, and half for all item cooldowns. Draw (Zoom / alt-fire): Paint a solid stroke of ink instead that blocks projectiles and characters from passing through. The stroke can be destroyed with a heavy melee, but deals spirit damage to the attacker.
abilities.name: Living Ink
tiers: On Empower: Gain +10% Fire Rate for 10s, stacking 5 times
+1s Cooldown Reduction Per Hit; +45% Bullet Damage; Increased Spirit Damage Scaling

abilities.desc: Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading slow and spirit damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing spirit damage in a larger area.
abilities.name: Flow State
tiers: On Slide: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 20% for 6s

abilities.desc: Choose a hero to be your subject, dealing spirit damage over time as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional spirit damage, suffer from stun, and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch, you permanently gain stats based on the hero.
abilities.name: Still Life
tiers: While Drawing: Gain 15 Health Regen, refreshed for 4s on pickup

abilities.desc: Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies Spirit. Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take spirit damage and suffer from Silence and slow, destroying the ink in the process.
abilities.name: Abstract Landscape
tiers: On Buff: +25% Spirit Lifesteal; +15 Spirit Power

heroes.name: Viscous
heroes.note: The Cube encases an ally or enemy — saving his carry or removing yours. Goo bounce disrupts grouped teams.

abilities.desc: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius. Multiple hits to the same target deal less damage. Goo puddles linger on the ground and apply a movement slow to enemies walking on them. You and your allies slide faster on goo puddles.
abilities.name: Splatter

abilities.desc: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
abilities.name: The Cube
tiers: Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20s Cooldown

abilities.desc: Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup. Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. Enemies can Parry this attack. You and your allies have increased Air Control.
abilities.name: Puddle Punch
tiers: -14s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.desc: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
abilities.name: Goo Ball
tiers: +7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling

heroes.name: Vyper
heroes.note: Rapid-fire poison assassin who slides through fights. Mobile burst, but squishy when pinned down.

abilities.desc: Throw a dagger dealing 50 spirit damage and applying a 28% slow; subsequent daggers against the same target stack 25 damage and 12% slow per stack, up to 3 stacks for 10s.
abilities.name: Screwjab Dagger
tiers: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
+2 Max Stacks; -2s Charge Delay; On Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

abilities.desc: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health. Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
abilities.name: Lethal Venom
tiers: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

abilities.desc: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.
abilities.name: Slither

abilities.desc: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
abilities.name: Petrifying Bola
tiers: +1s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

heroes.name: Warden
heroes.note: Duellist carry who wants to end in 20–30 min (53.6% win rate there, 48.6% in 40+ min games). Alchemical Flask binds, Last Stand cleanses — don't let him reach his ~22 min Mercurial Magnum spike comfortably.

abilities.desc: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
abilities.name: Alchemical Flask
tiers: -7s Cooldown and +2m Radius; Applies -30% Fire Rate

abilities.desc: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.
abilities.name: Willpower
tiers: +30% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling

abilities.desc: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.
abilities.name: Binding Word
tiers: Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s
-14s Cooldown; Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

abilities.desc: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. Immune to fear while Last Stand is active.
abilities.name: Last Stand
tiers: +4s Duration; Unstoppable and +30% Resists while channeling

heroes.name: Wraith
heroes.note: S-tier duellist. Card Trick homing cards, a teleport with a bullet shield, and Telekinesis lifts one target for a stun — she isolates and deletes one person, then leaves.

abilities.desc: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending on its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. Alt-cast to throw first card.
abilities.name: Card Trick
tiers: All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers

abilities.desc: Teleport to the targeted location.
abilities.name: Project Mind
tiers: 300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.desc: Temporarily boost your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage.
abilities.name: Full Auto
tiers: Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet

abilities.desc: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location. Slamming the target into the ground deals spirit damage, applying slow and prevents Stamina and movement-based items and abilities.
abilities.name: Telekinesis
tiers: +1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range

heroes.name: Yamato
heroes.note: Relentless pursuer with self-heal. Flying Slash range was cut to 23m on 30 Oct — she has to commit further to reach you now.

abilities.desc: Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike. Press Ability 1 or Fire to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.
abilities.name: Power Slash
tiers: +8m Cast Range; +150 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling

abilities.desc: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
abilities.name: Flying Slash
tiers: Alt-Cast to Grapple allies; +8m Cast Range; Gains 1 extra charge

abilities.desc: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
abilities.name: Crimson Slash
tiers: On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal

abilities.desc: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
abilities.name: Shadow Transformation

items.name: Close Quarters
items.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target. +20% Weapon Damage within 15m. Also grants +20% Melee Resist.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.desc: +30% Max Ammo and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals +45 bonus weapon damage (9s cooldown). Also grants +30 Bonus Health.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.desc: +45% Bullet Velocity and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Monster Rounds
